All the packages required for this exercise.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readr)
library(readxl)
library(lubridate)   # date-time parsing, floor_date()
library(knitr)       # kable() for the summary table
library(here)        # paths relative to the project root, not the code/ folder
```

Loading of all the datasets.

```{r}
# here() starts from the folder containing R4MarineScience.Rproj, so these
# paths work even though this file lives in code/
meta_data    <- read_csv(here("data", "workshop2", "estuary_metadata.csv"))
sonde_data   <- read_csv(here("data", "workshop2", "estuary_sonde_data.csv"),
                         col_types = cols(.default = col_character()))
species_dict <- read_csv(here("data", "workshop2", "species_dictionary.csv"))

# read_excel() reads only the first tab by default, so loop over every tab:
# excel_sheets() lists tabs, set_names() labels each with its tab name,
# map_dfr() reads and stacks them. col_types = "text" avoids bind errors
# from mixed-type columns across tabs.
catch_path <- here("data", "workshop2", "estuary_catch_log.xlsx")
catch_log <- excel_sheets(catch_path) |>
  set_names() |>
  map_dfr(\(s) read_excel(catch_path, sheet = s, col_types = "text"),
          .id = "tab")

# Create the output folders if they don't exist yet
dir.create(here("Output", "Tables"),  recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(here("Output", "Figures"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

Helpers and settings

```{r}
# Zone order, upstream -> downstream
zone_order <- c("Upstream", "Middle", "Downstream", "Marine")

# Lowercase, trim, non-alphanumerics -> single underscore
# ("LOWER ROSS" and "lower_ross" both become "lower_ross")
standardise <- function(x) {
  x |>
    str_to_lower() |>
    str_squish() |>
    str_replace_all("[^a-z0-9]+", "_") |>
    str_remove_all("^_|_$")
}

# Handles Excel serial numbers ("46143") and text dates. Day-first assumed.
parse_any_date <- function(x) {
  is_serial <- str_detect(x, "^\\d{5}(\\.\\d+)?$") & !is.na(x)
  out <- as.Date(rep(NA_real_, length(x)))
  out[is_serial]  <- as.Date(as.numeric(x[is_serial]), origin = "1899-12-30")
  out[!is_serial] <- as_date(parse_date_time(x[!is_serial],
                       orders = c("dmy", "ymd"),
                       tz = "Australia/Brisbane"))
  out
}
```

Phase 1: Ingestion and decontamination

```{r}
# Catch log: standardise site and species text
catch_log <- catch_log |>
  mutate(site    = standardise(site),
         species = standardise(species),
         count   = as.numeric(count),
         date    = parse_any_date(date)) |>
  select(site, date, species, count)

# Metadata: rename site_name -> site and standardise it so it matches the
# catch and sonde sites. Zone keeps its original capitalisation.
meta_data <- meta_data |>
  rename(site = site_name) |>
  mutate(site = standardise(site),
         zone = str_squish(zone))

# Dictionary: standardise the join key only; keep scientific names as written
species_dict <- species_dict |>
  mutate(common_name     = standardise(common_name),
         scientific_name = str_squish(scientific_name)) |>
  distinct(common_name, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Sonde: parse date-times, convert -999 sensor errors to NA
sonde_data <- sonde_data |>
  mutate(
    site      = standardise(site),
    timestamp = parse_date_time(timestamp,
                  orders = c("dmy HM", "dmy HMS", "ymd HM", "ymd HMS"),
                  tz = "Australia/Brisbane"),
    across(c(temperature, salinity, turbidity), as.numeric),
    across(c(temperature, salinity, turbidity), \(x) na_if(x, -999))
  )
```

Phase 2: Relational architecture

```{r}
# floor_date() snaps each timestamp to midnight -> one row per site per day
sonde_daily <- sonde_data |>
  mutate(date = as_date(floor_date(timestamp, unit = "day"))) |>
  group_by(site, date) |>
  summarise(mean_temp     = mean(temperature, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_salinity = mean(salinity,    na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

# Mutating join: common names -> scientific names (unmatched names dropped)
catch_sci <- catch_log |>
  left_join(species_dict, by = c("species" = "common_name")) |>
  filter(!is.na(scientific_name)) |>
  group_by(site, date, scientific_name) |>   # collapse repeat records
  summarise(count = sum(count, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
```

Phase 3: Zero-catch framework and the grand join

```{r}
# complete(): every species at every sampling event (site-date pairs in the
# log). nesting() avoids inventing days a site was never sampled.
# Done BEFORE joining so metadata and sonde columns are not NA-padded.
catch_complete <- catch_sci |>
  complete(scientific_name, nesting(site, date)) |>
  mutate(count = coalesce(count, 0))

master <- catch_complete |>
  left_join(meta_data,   by = "site") |>
  left_join(sonde_daily, by = c("site", "date")) |>
  mutate(zone = factor(zone, levels = zone_order))

write_csv(master, here("Output", "Tables", "master_dataset.csv"))
```

Phase 4: Statistical extraction

```{r}
# Deliverables list SD, Phase 4 asks for SE, so both are calculated
se <- function(x) sd(x, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(x)))

summary_table <- master |>
  group_by(scientific_name, zone) |>
  summarise(
    n          = n(),
    mean_count = mean(count, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_count   = sd(count,   na.rm = TRUE),
    se_count   = se(count),
    mean_sal   = mean(mean_salinity, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_sal     = sd(mean_salinity,   na.rm = TRUE),
    se_sal     = se(mean_salinity),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.double), \(x) round(x, 2)))

write_csv(summary_table, here("Output", "Tables", "summary_table.csv"))

summary_table |>
  transmute(
    Species = scientific_name,
    Zone    = zone,
    n       = n,
    `Catch (mean ± SE)`    = paste0(mean_count, " ± ", se_count),
    `Catch (mean ± SD)`    = paste0(mean_count, " ± ", sd_count),
    `Salinity (mean ± SE)` = paste0(mean_sal,   " ± ", se_sal),
    `Salinity (mean ± SD)` = paste0(mean_sal,   " ± ", sd_sal)
  ) |>
  kable()
```

Phase 5: Visual communication

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=7}
# Facet labels as plotmath: italic genus/species, upright "spp."
# e.g. 'italic("Acanthopagrus")~"spp."'
make_label <- function(x) {
  if_else(str_detect(x, " spp\\.$"),
          paste0('italic("', str_remove(x, " spp\\.$"), '")~"spp."'),
          paste0('italic("', x, '")'))
}

p <- master |>
  filter(!is.na(mean_salinity), !is.na(zone)) |>
  mutate(species_label = make_label(scientific_name)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = mean_salinity, y = count, colour = zone)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 1.8) +
  geom_smooth(aes(group = 1), method = "loess", se = TRUE,
              colour = "grey30", linewidth = 0.6, formula = y ~ x) +
  facet_wrap(~ species_label, scales = "free_y", labeller = label_parsed) +
  scale_colour_viridis_d(name = "Estuary zone\n(upstream to downstream)") +
  labs(x = "Mean daily salinity (PSU)",
       y = "Fish count per sampling event") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        legend.position  = "bottom")

p
ggsave(here("Output", "Figures", "abundance_vs_salinity.png"),
       p, width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 300)
```

Phase 6: Complementary figures

Stacked bar: assemblage composition by zone

```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
# Proportion of the total catch made up by each taxon in each zone.
# Shows how the community shifts rather than how each species changes alone.
p_comp <- master |>
  filter(!is.na(zone)) |>
  group_by(zone, scientific_name) |>
  summarise(total = sum(count), .groups = "drop") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = zone, y = total, fill = scientific_name)) +
  geom_col(position = "fill") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(name = "Taxon", option = "D") +
  labs(x = "Estuary zone (upstream to downstream)",
       y = "Share of total catch") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        legend.text = element_text(face = "italic"))  # note: "spp." also italic

p_comp
ggsave(here("Output", "Figures", "assemblage_composition.png"),
       p_comp, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

Bar graph: mean catch ± SE by zone

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=7}
# Uses the Phase 4 summary table, so the figure matches the table exactly.
p_bar <- summary_table |>
  filter(!is.na(zone)) |>
  mutate(species_label = make_label(scientific_name)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = zone, y = mean_count, fill = zone)) +
  geom_col(alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = pmax(mean_count - se_count, 0),
                    ymax = mean_count + se_count),
                width = 0.25) +
  facet_wrap(~ species_label, labeller = label_parsed) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "Estuary zone (upstream to downstream)",
       y = "Mean catch per sampling event (± SE)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))

p_bar
ggsave(here("Output", "Figures", "mean_catch_by_zone.png"),
       p_bar, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

Environmental context: water quality by zone

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=4.5}
# Confirms the zones really differ in water quality, which supports the
# salinity-gradient interpretation. Uses all 15-minute readings, with the
# -999 errors already converted to NA.
p_env <- sonde_data |>
  left_join(select(meta_data, site, zone), by = "site") |>
  filter(!is.na(zone)) |>
  mutate(zone = factor(zone, levels = zone_order)) |>
  select(zone, temperature, salinity, turbidity) |>
  pivot_longer(-zone, names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") |>
  filter(!is.na(value)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = zone, y = value, fill = zone)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~ variable, scales = "free_y",
             labeller = as_labeller(c(temperature = "Temperature (°C)",
                                      salinity    = "Salinity (PSU)",
                                      turbidity   = "Turbidity (NTU)"))) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "Estuary zone (upstream to downstream)", y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))

p_env
ggsave(here("Output", "Figures", "water_quality_by_zone.png"),
       p_env, width = 10, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```
